laws.rule: Driving into the special-regime zone (Lielupe bridge to Vaivari) costs €5 (about A$7.95 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) a day from 1 January 2026, paid by 23:59 on the day of entry. Passes: 7 days €20, 30 days €60, 90 days €100, 180 days €180, 365 days €270. Machines don't take cash. Electric vehicles are exempt.
laws.heading: Vehicle entry fee
